Frequently Asked Questions About Time Comparison

Everything you need to know about comparing times across countries

How do I compare time between different countries?

Simply search for a country in the search bar and select it. Add up to 6 countries to see their current times side by side. The time difference summary below automatically calculates differences between all selected countries.

What is the maximum number of countries I can compare?

You can compare up to 6 countries simultaneously. This limit ensures optimal performance and readability while giving you comprehensive time comparison capabilities.

How accurate are the time displays?

Our time comparator syncs with your device's system time and uses industry-standard IANA timezone databases to ensure accuracy within seconds. All times update in real-time every second.

Do you account for Daylight Saving Time (DST)?

Yes! All times automatically adjust for Daylight Saving Time where applicable. The timezone data includes DST rules for each region, ensuring you always see the correct local time.

Can I search by capital city instead of country?

Yes! The search feature allows you to search by either country name or capital city. For example, you can search 'London' or 'United Kingdom' to find the time in the UK.

How are time differences calculated?

Time differences are calculated based on the current moment in time. The system compares the local time in each selected country and shows you exactly how many hours ahead or behind each country is relative to others.
